clinical_nutrition_rationale.what_it_is: A vegetarian dietary supplement gummy formulated with citrus pectin (zero bovine or porcine gelatin), delivering 14 essential vitamins and minerals including Vitamins A, C, D2, E, B3, B5, B6, B12, Folic Acid, Biotin, Iodine, and Zinc, naturally flavored with real strawberry juice concentrate and sweetened without high-fructose corn syrup.
clinical_nutrition_rationale.why_it_is_needed: Pill fatigue is a major clinical cause of non-compliance among young adults and teenagers who dislike swallowing large pharmaceutical multivitamin tablets. Skipping daily micronutrients leads to impaired carbohydrate-lipid metabolism, afternoon lethargy, and recurrent low-grade viral susceptibility. SEIZE THE DAY solves this: it offers an enjoyable, highly bioavailable chewable delivery vehicle that guarantees daily adherence, supplying essential co-factors (B-complex) for mitochondrial ATP production alongside antioxidants (Vitamins C & E, Zinc) to support immune defense and daily vitality.

products.name: n by Nutrilite™ I-Candy Lutein & Zeaxanthin Gummy
products.usp: Vegetarian ocular defense gummy delivering natural Marigold flower-derived Lutein and Zeaxanthin in refreshing orange flavor to shield eyes from digital screen blue light and reduce eye strain.

clinical_nutrition_rationale.what_it_is: A targeted ocular health gummy formulated with natural carotenoids extracted from Marigold Flowers (*Tagetes erecta*), delivering clinically calibrated amounts of Lutein and Zeaxanthin in a 5:1 biological ratio, combined with Vitamin E in a vegetarian pectin-based orange chew.
clinical_nutrition_rationale.why_it_is_needed: Prolonged screen exposure (smartphones, laptops, tablets, gaming) emits high-energy visible (HEV) blue light (400-500 nm), which generates reactive oxygen species in the macula lutea, causing digital eye strain (asthenopia), dry gritty eyes, headaches, and circadian rhythm sleep disruptions. Lutein and Zeaxanthin are dietary carotenoids that selectively cross the blood-retinal barrier to accumulate in the fovea centralis. I-Candy delivers these carotenoids in a convenient daily gummy format: they function as an optical blue-light filter, absorbing high-energy wavelengths and quenching free radicals, thereby alleviating digital eye fatigue and preserving long-term retinal integrity.

Maintains the natural biological 5:1 macular ratio, concentrating in the fovea centralis.

clinical_nutrition_rationale.what_it_is: A vegetarian bone mineral gummy providing elemental Calcium, Cholecalciferol (Vitamin D3), and Vitamin K2 (MK-7) in a refreshing green apple pectin base, free from chalky residue or artificial preservatives.
clinical_nutrition_rationale.why_it_is_needed: Over 80% of young adults and teenagers fail to reach peak bone mass by age 25 due to low milk consumption, lack of outdoor sunlight exposure, and carbonated soda intake (which leaches calcium). Taking plain calcium tablets is often abandoned due to large pill size and constipation. Love Your Bones makes skeletal protection enjoyable: Vitamin D3 drives intestinal calcium absorption, while Vitamin K2 directs calcium into the growing bone matrix and prevents arterial deposits, making it the ideal modern format for maintaining skeletal and dental strength.
